newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms on client demand, reserve payments.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms on client demand, reserve payments.

text.p: The rouble firmed on Wednesday as banks sought funds for clients and monthly reserve requirements, and dealers said the shortage was more acute after Tuesday's dollar sales by the central bank.
roubles/dollar Mar 5 midday Mar 5 early Mar 4 close

"Some banks were seeking roubles as they must transfer compulsory reserves by the 10th. Besides, roubles are scarce as banks bought many dollars from the central bank yesterday," Inkombank dealer Vladislav Savelyev said.
Moscow Business World bank dealer Nikolai Zolotaryov said one bank was selling dollars actively, apparently fulfilling a client order.
